searchText: Did you include the EL in the 100GB or was that just the CL? If EL was included, the mempool could be inflated due to spamming. It shouldn't account for 100GB though. ya the EL would've been included in that disk usage, so perhaps it was the geth `blobpool` dir, I'll keep an eye on the growth of that dir on the newer nodes, thanks for the heads up about that.

excerpts.content:
Did you include the EL in the 100GB or was that just the CL?

If EL was included, the mempool could be inflated due to spamming. It shouldn't account for 100GB though.
